info.title: Agentgates Compute API
info.description:
Confidential computers for AI swarms: a sealed VM (Intel TDX) for each agent, for trading swarms or any other swarm, by the hour, paid in USDC over x402 on Base, Polygon or Solana. No signup and no API key: the paying wallet owns the machine, and every machine proves what it runs (remote attestation).

What's new:
- 2026-11-05, Buy 15 minutes: Machines now sell by the quarter-hour: send "minutes": 15, 30 or 45 in place of "hours" on a create or a renewal. A payment refused for lack of USDC now says what the wallet can buy instead (canBuy).
- 2026-11-05, Fewer failed changes: Sending a machine the setup it already runs now changes nothing and keeps it up. A machine busy with another change answers 409 with Retry-After: send the same call again then.
- 2026-11-02, x402 version 2: Pay with x402 version 2 or 1: every 402 also carries a PAYMENT-REQUIRED header, and a PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header pays like X-PAYMENT.
All of it: https://api.agentgates.ai/changelog.json
info.x-guidance:
Rent confidential computers for an AI swarm, one CVM (Intel TDX) per agent, by the hour with USDC over x402. No signup: the wallet that pays owns the machine.
1. GET /api/compute/catalog: plans and the price per network for each.
2. POST /api/compute/deployments with {"plan","hours","image"} (or "compose" instead of "image"). The answer is a free 402 quote: its accepts array carries one exact price per network (Base, Polygon, Solana).
3. Pay one entry and send the same POST again with the X-PAYMENT header. The answer is 202 with a deploymentId.
4. Poll GET /api/compute/deployments/{id}, signed by the paying wallet (X-Wallet-Auth), until status is running: endpoint and attestation are then live.
5. POST /api/compute/deployments/{id}/renew with {"hours"} adds time, the same 402 loop. Any wallet may pay a renewal; only the owner reads, controls or destroys the machine.
Full contract, signing details and live prices: GET /api/compute/docs.
Quarter-hours: send {"minutes": 15} (or 30 or 45) in place of "hours" on a create or a renewal, on every plan but GPU.

post.summary: Create a confidential computer for an agent or a swarm
post.description: Send it without X-PAYMENT for a free 402 quote, pay one accepts entry, then send the same request with X-PAYMENT. The paying wallet owns the machine. A wallet with a prepaid balance may send X-Wallet-Auth (or a compute key as Authorization: Bearer) and no X-PAYMENT to pay from it instead. The price depends on the plan, the hours and the network; the 402 carries it exactly.

hours.description: Hours this payment buys, within the plan's own minHours and maxHours. The clock starts when the machine runs.

minutes.description: In place of hours: minutes this payment buys, on every plan but GPU. A quarter-hour costs more per hour than an hour (one settle per payment). Send hours or minutes, not both.

image.description: One container image, served on host port 8080. Send image or compose.

port.description: The container port behind host port 8080 when image is used (default 80).

compose.description: A docker-compose.yml as a string. It must publish a port. Send compose or image.

env.description: Env values, sealed to the machine and never stored.

aliasTarget.description: Optional "<service>:<port>" in your compose, to serve on a dedicated domain (see the docs).

202.description: Paid. The machine is provisioning: poll GET /api/compute/deployments/{deploymentId}. A retry with the same X-PAYMENT returns the same machine.

status.description: provisioning, running, grace, stopped, suspended, destroyed or failed

endpoint.description: The machine's URL once it runs.

verifyUrl.description: A public page with the machine's attestation.

400.description: The request was refused before any payment (a bad body or setup); the error says why

402.description: Payment Required: the quote. accepts carries one entry per network, each with its own exact maxAmountRequired (USDC atomic units). Quoting is free and repeatable; nothing was charged.

409.description: payment_in_progress: this payment is being processed, send the same X-PAYMENT again after retry-after. payment_already_spent: it matches no receipt, list your machines. Never sign a new one.

503.description: No capacity right now; nothing was charged

post.description: The same 402 loop as a create, priced at the machine's plan for the hours asked. The hours stack on the end of the clock, so renewing early never loses time.
